Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2x2 eye-expression atlas for Daggerfall Unity 64x64 pixel portrait animation
Primary request: Edit the supplied eyes-reference-grid.png as the sole reference image. Return only a clean 2x2 atlas of the same repeated upper portrait halves, row-major: open, half closed, fully closed, repeated open. Keep each cell same framing and size as the reference half (64:35 aspect per cell); keep exact two-eye spacing and alignment. This is the AFRAID expression for NPC088: worried, pinched inner brows and alert lids, clearly distinct from sad; do not make merely circular wide eyes. The lids cover the same eyeball vertically; never move glints down, shrink or round irises, shift gaze, or let the lower lid cross the iris. Closed phase hides all iris and sclera. Repeat same brows and stationary orbital creases in all phases. Preserve face identity, eye spacing, original soft pixel-art rendering, muted warm tan skin, olive/brown eye shadows, gray-violet irises and soft contrast. Preserve all nose, cheek, hair, forehead, background and framing from the reference. Restrict changes to brows, lids, eyes and expression creases within the existing eye area. No full-face redesign, no extra objects, no text, no borders, no labels, no watermark. No heavy near-black brows, orange skin patches, bright white flashes, smooth vector shapes, or round stretched irises. Produce authentic crisp native pixel-art structure, not circles or smooth vector eyes.
